title: Powers, Roots & Logarithms
description: Rules for powers, roots and logarithms.

√ Powers, Roots & Logarithms

1. Power laws

$a^n = a \cdot a \cdot \ldots \cdot a$ ($n$ factors). For $a, b \neq 0$:

$$\begin{aligned} a^m \cdot a^n &= a^{m+n} & \frac{a^m}{a^n} &= a^{m-n} \\ (a^m)^n &= a^{mn} & (ab)^n &= a^n b^n \end{aligned}$$

$$a^0 = 1, \qquad a^{-n} = \frac{1}{a^n}$$

Typical mistakes

  • $a^m + a^n \neq a^{m+n}$, $\;(a + b)^n \neq a^n + b^n$
  • $-2^4 = -16$, but $(-2)^4 = 16$
  • $(2x)^3 = 8x^3 \neq 2x^3$

2. Roots

$\sqrt[n]{a}$ is the non-negative solution of $x^n = a$ ($a \ge 0$).

$$\sqrt[n]{a^m} = a^{\frac{m}{n}}, \qquad \sqrt{x^2} = |x|$$

$$\sqrt{ab} = \sqrt{a}\sqrt{b}, \qquad \sqrt{\frac{a}{b}} = \frac{\sqrt{a}}{\sqrt{b}}, \qquad \sqrt{a + b} \neq \sqrt{a} + \sqrt{b}$$

Examples

$$\sqrt{50} = 5\sqrt{2}, \qquad \frac{1}{\sqrt{5} - \sqrt{3}} = \frac{\sqrt{5} + \sqrt{3}}{2}, \qquad 8^{\frac{2}{3}} = 4$$

3. Logarithms

$$\log_a x = y \iff a^y = x \qquad (a > 0,\ a \neq 1,\ x > 0)$$

$\ln = \log_e$ (natural logarithm), $\lg = \log_{10}$.

Logarithm laws

$$\begin{aligned} \log_a(xy) &= \log_a x + \log_a y \\ \log_a\tfrac{x}{y} &= \log_a x - \log_a y \\ \log_a(x^r) &= r \log_a x \end{aligned}$$

Change of base and inverse

$$\log_a x = \frac{\ln x}{\ln a}, \qquad a^{\log_a x} = x, \qquad \log_a(a^x) = x$$

Careful

$\log(x + y) \neq \log x + \log y$. Logarithms exist only for positive numbers.
